DreamShaper_8.signature: Fantasy倾向, soft glow, centered composition, dramatic lighting, generic beauty
DreamShaper_8.strengths: Character concept, fantasy atmosphere, painterly quality
DreamShaper_8.weaknesses: Generic faces, over-glow, center-weighted composition, lack of specificity
DreamShaper_8.detection: Check for: centered subject, dramatic backlight, soft glow halo, generic fantasy elements
DreamShaper_8.counter_strategy: Specify exact composition, reject center-weighting, demand specific而不是generic elements

DreamShaper_XL.signature: Higher detail, more photographic tendency, stronger material rendering
DreamShaper_XL.strengths: Material quality, detail density, environment atmosphere
DreamShaper_XL.weaknesses: Can become over-detailed, photorealism bias, less stylized control
DreamShaper_XL.detection: Check for: over-rendering, photorealism creep, loss of intentional style
DreamShaper_XL.counter_strategy: Specify style DNA explicitly, reject photorealism when not intended

SVG.signature: Flat construction, geometric shapes, clean edges, limited gradients
SVG.weaknesses: Can look flat/childlike if not designed, limited material suggestion
SVG.detection: Check for: over-simplification, loss of depth, generic icon aesthetic
SVG.counter_strategy: Use layering, gradient economy, sophisticated shape language

CSS.signature: Box model thinking, gradient-heavy, shadow-dependent, responsive grid
CSS.weaknesses: Generic SaaS aesthetic, gradient overuse, shadow dependency
CSS.detection: Check for: gradient backgrounds, box shadows, generic card layouts
CSS.counter_strategy: Subvert grid expectations, use unconventional layouts, limit gradients

WebGL_Shader.signature: Mathematical patterns, noise-based, infinite detail, procedural aesthetic
WebGL_Shader.strengths: Originality, material exploration, motion, infinite resolution
WebGL_Shader.weaknesses: Can become demo-quality, lack of compositional intent, noise-as-fidelity
WebGL_Shader.detection: Check for: random noise patterns, demo aesthetic, lack of focal hierarchy
WebGL_Shader.counter_strategy: Apply compositional rules, create focal hierarchy, intentional color

Blender.signature: Physical accuracy, realistic materials, studio lighting, product render aesthetic
Blender.strengths: Geometry accuracy, material quality, lighting control
Blender.weaknesses: Can become generic 3D render, lack of artistic voice, over-physical
Blender.detection: Check for: generic studio lighting, perfect materials, lack of stylization
Blender.counter_strategy: Stylize materials, use unconventional lighting, add artistic imperfection

detection_method: Compare output against known tool signatures. If output matches signature, tool is dictating aesthetic.
counter_strategy: Specify art direction BEFORE tool selection. Reject outputs that match tool signature without artistic intent.
quality_gate: If output could be produced by a generic prompt without art direction, reject.
